title: От Луки 19 — Luke 19
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: “My house will be a house of prayer,”
cases.explain: «Дом» is the subject of «будет» (will be) — the subject of a sentence takes the nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.translation: “My house will be a house of prayer,”
cases.explain: In the «X будет Y» (X will be Y) construction with быть, the predicate noun Y goes into the instrumental → домом.

cases.translation: Jesus drives the merchants out of the temple.
cases.explain: The preposition «из» (out of) always governs the genitive → храма.

cases.translation: Jesus taught daily in the temple.
cases.explain: «В» marking a fixed location (no motion — “was teaching in”) takes the prepositional → храме.

cases.sentence: Сказав это, Иисус пошел дальше к ___.
cases.translation: Having said this, Jesus went on farther toward Jerusalem.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» (toward) always governs the dative → Иерусалиму.

cases.sentence: Тем, кто это слушал, Иисус рассказал ___.
cases.translation: To those who were listening, Jesus told a parable.
cases.explain: «Притча» is the direct object of «рассказал» (told) → accusative притчу.

cases.sentence: И когда он приблизился к месту, где дорога спускается с ___,
cases.translation: And when he approached the place where the road goes down from the Mount of Olives,
cases.explain: The preposition «с» meaning “down from” governs the genitive → горы.

cases.sentence: Если кто-нибудь вас спросит... скажите, он нужен ___»,
cases.translation: “If anyone asks you... say, the Lord needs it,”
cases.explain: The short-form predicate «нужен» (“is needed”) takes the dative of the one who has need of something → Господу.

cases.sentence: Наступят дни, когда твои враги обнесут тебя осадными ___,
cases.translation: The days will come when your enemies will throw up siege ramparts against you,
cases.explain: The instrumental marks the means by which they will surround you, governed by «обнесут» (will encircle/throw up around) → валами.

reading.ru: Иисус вошел в Иерихон и проходил через город.
reading.question: What was Jesus doing when he came to Jericho?
options: Entering and passing through the city
reading.correct: Entering and passing through the city
reading.explain: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through the city, as the opening line states.

reading.ru: Тогда, чтобы увидеть его, Закхей забежал вперед и залез на тутовое дерево, росшее в том месте, где Иисус должен был проходить.
reading.question: How did Zacchaeus manage to see Jesus despite being short?
options: He ran ahead and climbed a sycamore tree
He asked the crowd to let him through
reading.correct: He ran ahead and climbed a sycamore tree
reading.explain: Being too short to see over the crowd, Zacchaeus ran ahead and climbed a sycamore tree along Jesus's path.

reading.ru: «Господи, половину моего имущества я раздам бедным, а если я с кого-либо взял лишнее, я возвращу ему вчетверо».
reading.question: What did Zacchaeus promise to do?
options: Give half his goods to the poor and repay four times anyone he cheated
Give all his money to Jesus
reading.correct: Give half his goods to the poor and repay four times anyone he cheated
reading.explain: Zacchaeus declares he will give half his possessions to the poor and repay fourfold anyone he has wrongfully overcharged.

reading.ru: Один знатный человек отправлялся в далекую страну, чтобы получить царскую власть и вернуться.
reading.question: How does the parable of the entrusted money begin?
options: A nobleman went to a far country to receive royal power and return
A king built a new palace
A servant ran away with the master's money
A rich man planted a vineyard
reading.correct: A nobleman went to a far country to receive royal power and return
reading.explain: The parable opens with a nobleman traveling to a distant country to be made king and then return.

reading.ru: «Ты хороший слуга, ты был верен в малом, получи теперь в управление десять городов».
reading.question: What reward did the first servant receive for earning ten more minas?
options: A place at the king's table
reading.explain: Because he was faithful with a little, the master gave the first servant authority over ten cities.

reading.ru: Ты берешь там, где не клал, и жнешь там, где не сеял».
reading.question: What excuse did the third servant give for hiding his mina in a cloth?
options: He was afraid because the master was a harsh man who takes what he didn't lay down and reaps what he didn't sow
He gave it to the poor instead
He was robbed on the road
reading.correct: He was afraid because the master was a harsh man who takes what he didn't lay down and reaps what he didn't sow
reading.explain: The third servant said he feared the master, describing him as a harsh man who takes what he did not lay down and reaps what he did not sow.

reading.ru: А моих врагов, которые не хотели, чтобы я царствовал над ними, приведите сюда и убейте прямо передо мной».
reading.question: What did the returning king command be done to his enemies?
options: Bring them and kill them before him
Forgive them and let them go
reading.correct: Bring them and kill them before him
reading.explain: The king orders that the enemies who did not want him to reign be brought and killed in front of him.

reading.ru: Они привели осленка к Иисусу и, набросив на него свои плащи, посадили на него Иисуса.
reading.question: What did the disciples do with the colt they found?
options: Brought it to Jesus, threw cloaks on it, and sat him on it
Gave it back to its owners immediately
reading.correct: Brought it to Jesus, threw cloaks on it, and sat him on it
reading.explain: The disciples brought the colt to Jesus, threw their cloaks on it, and set Jesus on it.

reading.ru: «Благословен Царь, который приходит во имя Господа!
reading.question: What did the crowd of disciples shout as Jesus descended the Mount of Olives?
options: Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!
Hosanna to the son of David alone!
reading.correct: Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!
reading.explain: As Jesus descended the Mount of Olives, the crowd of disciples praised God, shouting that the King who comes in the name of the Lord is blessed.

reading.ru: Наступят дни, когда твои враги обнесут тебя осадными валами, окружат тебя и стеснят тебя со всех сторон.
reading.question: What did Jesus prophesy would happen to Jerusalem?
options: Enemies would build siege ramparts, surround it, and hem it in on every side
It would be blessed with abundant harvests
It would become the capital of a new kingdom
Its temple would be rebuilt larger
reading.correct: Enemies would build siege ramparts, surround it, and hem it in on every side
reading.explain: Jesus wept over Jerusalem and foretold that enemies would besiege it, surrounding and hemming it in on all sides.

reading.ru: «Написано», — говорил Он им, «Дом мой будет домом молитвы, а вы превратили его в разбойничье логово».
reading.question: What did Jesus say about the temple when he drove out the merchants?
options: It should be a house of prayer, but they had made it a den of robbers
It should be rebuilt with gold
It belonged to the tax collectors
reading.correct: It should be a house of prayer, but they had made it a den of robbers
reading.explain: Jesus quotes Scripture that his house should be a house of prayer, but they turned it into a den of robbers.
